sentences.en: The stained glass painted colorful pictures on the church floor.
sentences.zh: 1. 彩色玻璃在教堂的地面上描绘出五彩斑斓的画面。

sentences.en: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
sentences.zh: 2. 这幅画与那幅相比色彩丰富，十分鲜艳。

sentences.en: Can you match this coat with something a little more colorful?
sentences.zh: 3. 你能为这件外套搭配一些更鲜艳的配饰吗？

senses.zh: 富有色彩的;鲜艳的 - 多姿多彩的;富有趣味的;生动的
